mapper.select: SELECT t.province_id, t.province_name, t.city_id, t.city_name, t.county_id, t.county_name, t.tenant_id, ti.tenant_name, t.industry_code, t.app_ver_code FROM vm_checkpoint_device_info_t t, vm_device_info_t d,sys_tenant_info ti WHERE t.delete_flag = 0 AND t.device_code = d.device_code AND d.delete_flag = '0' and ti.del_flag = '0' AND t.tenant_id = ti.tenant_id AND t.device_code = #{deviceCode} AND t.channel_code = #{channelCode} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vm_order_devices a, vm_order_customer b WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 AND b.delete_flag = 0 AND a.order_code = b.order_code AND b.ord_status in(0, 1, 2) AND a.device_code = #{deviceCode})
